title: Covariance as a centered uniform inner product
statement: Let $f,g$ be real-valued functions on the sign cube of dimension $n$. Their covariance is the uniform inner product of their centered functions: $\operatorname{Cov}(f,g)=\langle f-\mathbb E f,\,g-\mathbb E g\rangle_{\mathrm{unif}}$.
hypotheses_covered: Real-valued functions $f,g$ on the sign cube of dimension $n$
